title: Laule'a at the Mauna Lani Resort #14 | KEY.co
h1: Laule'a at the Mauna Lani Resort #14
description_expanded: Set along the lush fairways of the Mauna Lani Resort, this four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath luxury villa offers a seamless blend of refined comfort and island beauty. With panoramic golf course views and the majestic silhouette of Mauna Kea as your backdrop, every moment feels elevated—whether you're enjoying coffee on a private lanai or gathering poolside with friends and family. Three spacious king suites, each with spa-inspired baths and private balconies, provide retreat-like privacy, while the downstairs guest suite and twin room offer ideal flexibility for families. The home’s open-concept design flows effortlessly from vaulted great room to gourmet kitchen to covered outdoor lanai, where a built-in BBQ, pool, and spa invite leisurely afternoons and al fresco dining under the stars. Lush tropical landscaping enhances the sense of serenity and seclusion, all within minutes of Mauna Lani’s world-class golf, black sand beaches, upscale shopping, and dining. Designed for those who crave both luxury and connection, this villa is a rare retreat where every detail encourages relaxation, exploration, and unforgettable island moments.
